title: Italian: 500 Most Common Words

sources.name: Original educational synthesis from general knowledge

description: For beginners learning 500 common Italian words, with English meanings, grammatical labels and original examples. Latin-script headwords serve as romanization; selection is not a fixed corpus ranking.

cards.back: che — that; which; what (conjunction or pronoun)
gli — the (masculine plural article before certain sounds); to him (pronoun)
lo — the (masculine article before certain sounds); him; it (pronoun)
uno — one; a (masculine numeral or article)
loro — they; them; their (pronoun or possessive)
suo — his; her; its (masculine singular possessive)
sua — his; her; its (feminine singular possessive)
vostro — your; yours (plural possessor, masculine singular noun)
cosa — thing; what (feminine noun or interrogative)
come — how; as; like (adverb or conjunction)
poco — little; not much (adverb or determiner)
tanto — so much; a lot (adverb or determiner)
troppo — too much; too (adverb or determiner)
qualche — some; a few (determiner with singular noun)

cards.example: Il libro è su quel tavolo.

cards.back: tra — between; among; in a period of time (preposition)
fra — between; among; in a period of time (preposition)
cards.example: Il bar è fra due negozi.
Il gatto è sotto il letto.

cards.back: sopra — above; on top (preposition or adverb)
cards.example: Il quadro è sopra il divano.
La bici è contro il muro.

cards.back: fino — until; up to (preposition, often with a)
potere — to be able to; can (verb)
dovere — to have to; must; to owe (verb)
sapere — to know a fact; to know how (verb)
stare — to stay; to be in a state (verb)
guardare — to look at; to watch (verb)
portare — to carry; to bring; to wear (verb)
passare — to pass; to spend time (verb)
uscire — to go out; to exit (verb)
conoscere — to know; to be acquainted with (verb)

cards.example: È difficile credere a questa storia.
Una pianta può morire senza acqua.

cards.back: servire — to serve; to be needed (verb)

cards.example: È bello amare ed essere amati.

cards.back: piacere — to be pleasing to; to like (verb with reversed experiencer construction)
cards.example: Questo libro può piacere a tutti.

cards.back: indossare — to wear; to put on (verb)
salire — to go up; to get on (verb)
scendere — to go down; to get off (verb)

cards.example: Il cane è dietro la porta.

cards.back: capello — hair; strand of hair (masculine noun)

cards.example: Il corpo ha bisogno di riposo.

cards.back: prego — you're welcome; please, go ahead (interjection)
